Pattern lines and texture flow follow the body outline. Bilaterally symmetrical, recognizable limbs, visible sense organs. Habitat cue (grassland): plainer coat with fewer markings for an open habitat. One creature, full body, side three-quarter view, plain light background, natural history illustration.
